machineTranslatedNote: A machine translated Anubis into your browser's language, and the translation isn't fully supported: some of it may be wrong or unclear, so use it with caution. To see Anubis in English, set your browser's language to English.
extDescription: Weighs your search results: tag, rerank, and hide sites, with lists anyone can publish.
commandToggleHidden: Show hidden results, or hide them again

popupNoSites: Nothing yet. Use the ⚖ button on any search result to rank its site.
popupRankPin: Pin $1 to the top of search results
popupSiteChoice: Choose how much of the site this applies to
popupHintMine: Your choice for $1, on every search.
popupHintMineTags: Your choice for $1, on every search, added to your tag settings.
popupHintLists: $1 by $2. Choose one to decide yourself.
popupHintNone: Your choice applies on every search.
tagListsPickerHint: Adding one changes only your list.
popupTagInvalid: Enter a tag name with at least one letter or number.
popupTagAlreadySet: That tag is already on this site.
tagSiteReason: Why this site fits the “$1” tag (optional)
popupNotSearch: Search on Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave, or another supported engine to see what Anubis changes.
loadMoreTitle: Add the next page of results to this page and rank them together
loadMoreEmpty: $1 sent no results for page $2. It may want you to confirm you’re not a robot first.
loadMoreRepeat: $1 sent the same results again for page $2, so there are no more.
loadMoreBusy: $1 asked Anubis to slow down before page $2. Try again in a minute.
loadMoreSlow: $1 took too long to send page $2.
loadMoreOpenTitle: Open it in a new tab to see what $1 sent
reportProblemTitle: Open a bug report on GitHub, with Anubis’s version and your browser filled in
summaryShortActedRemoved: Anubis changed $1 of $2 and cleaned up the page.
summaryUnchanged_other: Anubis left all $1 results as they were.
summaryUnchangedPages: Anubis left all $1 results from $2 pages as they were.
menuSuggest: Should a list include it? Suggest it to $1.
menuSuggestTitle: Propose $1 to $2 on its issue tracker
menuReportTitle: Tell $1 it’s wrong about this result, on its issue tracker
offerTrust: A list can hide, rank, and tag sites in your results. Only subscribe to lists you trust.
offerPermission: Your browser will then ask to let Anubis read from $1, the site the list is on.
welcomeIntro: It tags, reranks, and hides search results, following your own choices and the lists you subscribe to.
welcomePinWhy: Its toolbar button shows what Anubis did on the page, turns it on or off, and ranks the site you're on.
welcomePinChrome: Press the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) next to the address bar, then the pin beside Anubis.
welcomePinEdge: Press the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) next to the address bar, then the eye beside Anubis.
welcomePinOpera: Press the Extensions button (the cube) next to the address bar, then the pin beside Anubis.
welcomePinFirefox: Press the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) next to the address bar, then the gear beside Anubis, and choose Pin to Toolbar.
welcomePinAndroid: Anubis is in the browser's menu, under Extensions.
welcomeSearchHow: Search as you usually do. To hide, rank, or tag a site, point at one of its results and press the ⚖ button.
welcomeSearchFor: Search for “$1” to see tags from your lists:
welcomeListsIntro: Lists tag, raise, lower, or hide sites for you. You start with these:
welcomeListsNone: Lists tag, raise, lower, or hide sites for you. You aren't subscribed to any yet.
welcomeListsMore: Turn these off, or find more lists, in the settings.
syncIntro: Your list and settings on your other computers, and in your other browsers.
syncFirefox: Your list, settings, tag choices, and subscriptions are saved in Firefox's sync storage. Firefox copies them to your other computers when you're signed in to Firefox with Add-ons ticked in its sync settings. It syncs about every 10 minutes, or when you choose Sync Now.
syncFirefoxAndroid: Firefox for Android doesn't sync add-on data, so your list, settings, tag choices, and subscriptions stay on this device. To sync them, connect a WebDAV server below.
syncChrome: Your list, settings, tag choices, and subscriptions are saved in the browser's sync storage. The browser copies them to your other computers when you're signed in to it with extensions syncing.
syncUsage: They take $1 KB of the $2 KB sync has room for.
syncTooBig: Your list is too big for sync, so it's saved on this device only. Your settings, tag choices, and subscriptions still sync.
webdavIntro: Firefox and Chrome don't natively sync with one another. To share between them, you can connect the same WebDAV storage in each. Koofr and InfiniCLOUD have free plans, and self-hosted options such as Nextcloud work as well. Anubis keeps one file there, anubis-sync.json, and combines the changes from each browser.
webdavHelp: Where to get an address and a password
webdavAddressHint: The service's WebDAV address, starting with https://
listPermissionDenied: Anubis needs permission to read $1 to update this list.
webdavPasswordHint: Most services give you a separate password for apps. Use that one.
webdavEncrypt: Encrypt the sync file end to end (recommended)
webdavEncryptionHint: Use a long, unique passphrase in every browser (at least 12 characters). It is saved in this browser only, never sent to the server. If you forget it, the server copy can't be recovered.
webdavCorrectPassphraseHint: Use the same passphrase you set in the other browser. It is saved here only and never sent to the server.
webdavChangePassphraseHint: Anubis checks the current passphrase before changing the server file. Enter the new passphrase in every other browser before its next sync.
webdavChangePassphraseHelp: What happens when you change it
webdavEncryptionShort: Use an encryption passphrase of at least 12 characters.
webdavEncrypted: The sync file is encrypted end to end. Its passphrase is saved in this browser only; the server cannot read the contents. Use the same passphrase in each browser. If you forget it, the server copy can't be recovered.
webdavEncryptionPending: Encryption is set up here. The next successful sync will encrypt the server copy. Use the same passphrase in each browser.
webdavEncryptionMissing: This browser has no encryption passphrase set. Use the same passphrase as the other browser to read an encrypted file. A plain sync file can be read by the server operator.
webdavPrivacy: With encryption on, only encrypted data goes to this server; your passphrase is saved here and never sent. Without encryption, the server can read the sync file. Your WebDAV login is saved here and sent to this server to sign in.
webdavBadAddress: Enter the service's WebDAV address, starting with https://
webdavMissingLogin: Enter the user name and password too.
webdavDenied: Anubis needs your permission to send your list to $1.
webdavWhen: Changes go to the server a few seconds after you make them. Changes from your other browsers come in when the browser starts and when you search, at most every 5 minutes.
webdavDisconnected: Disconnected. The file stays on the server, and your list and settings stay here.
webdavErrorAuth: The server didn't accept the user name or password. Many services need an app password here, not your usual one.
webdavErrorForbidden: The server doesn't let this account save files there.
webdavErrorFolder: There's no folder at that address on the server. Check the address.
webdavErrorPermission: Anubis no longer has permission to sync with $1. Press Sync now to allow it again.
webdavErrorNetwork: Couldn't reach $1. Check the address and your connection.
webdavErrorFile: The anubis-sync.json file there isn't one Anubis can read, so it was left alone. Use another folder.
webdavErrorNeedsPassphrase: This sync file is encrypted. Enter its passphrase; nothing was changed.
webdavErrorWrongPassphrase: That passphrase couldn't decrypt the sync file. Check it; the server file was left unchanged.
webdavErrorUnencrypted: This connection was encrypted before, but the server now has a plain-text sync file. It was left unchanged. Check the server file before syncing again.
webdavErrorChanged: The sync file changed during the passphrase change, or the server cannot protect it from concurrent edits. Nothing was overwritten. Sync again and retry.
webdavErrorUnconfirmed: The connection to $1 dropped while it saved the file, so Anubis can't tell which passphrase it has now. The old passphrase is still saved here. If the next sync says it's wrong, enter the new one.
webdavErrorServer: The server answered with an error (HTTP $1). Try again later.
appearanceIntro: How Anubis looks here and on search pages.
themeHint: Auto follows your browser here and in the menu on each result, and each search engine’s own light or dark mode for the rest of what Anubis adds to its pages.
paletteHint: Plain draws everything Anubis adds to search pages in grey, with no gold. Tags lose their colours and are told apart by their names. Settings and the toolbar popup stay gold.
hideStyleHint: Remove takes them off the page; the summary above the results counts them, and Show hidden brings them back. Collapse leaves one slim line for each run of hidden results. Dim fades them.
rerankHint: Move raised and pinned results up and lowered ones down, like a Brave Goggle.
deeperAutoHint: Add the next pages of results to the first one and rank them together, so a site you pinned on page 3 rises to the top. “Load more results” above the results does the same when you ask. Type how many pages to add, from 0 (off) to $1.
deeperTipOff: Off: more results load only when you press “Load more results”.
deeperTipTime_other: Adds about $1 seconds to each search.
deeperTipFew: $1 Engines rarely mind a few pages.
deeperTipSome: $1 Some engines may start asking you to confirm you’re not a robot.
deeperTipMany: $1 Google and Bing often ask you to confirm you’re not a robot after this many. Some engines run out of pages before then.
chipsHint: Show tags and rankings under each result title.
summaryHint: Show a one-line summary of what Anubis changed above the results.
enabledHint: Turn this off to leave search pages alone without uninstalling.
enginesIntro: Anubis works on web results from these engines. Results are found by page structure where possible, so small redesigns don’t break it.
enginesTrouble: Anubis doing nothing on a search page?
shareIntro: Keep a copy of everything, bring your sites over from another tool, or publish your list for others to subscribe to.
publishIntro: No server needed: a public git repository is the database, and pull requests are how people contribute.
publishStepDownload: Download your list below. Set its $1, $2, and $3 lines at the top.
publishStepRepository: Create a public GitHub repository (or a gist) and add the file, e.g. $1.
publishStepIssues: Add $1 so people can suggest sites to your list from the menu on each result.
publishStepShare: Share the file’s link. People paste it into Lists → Add a list.
publishStepDirectory: Want it under More lists for everyone? Open a pull request adding it to $1.
importIntro: Coming from uBlacklist or HOHSER? Paste your rules or export here and the sites join your list. Hidden stays hidden, HOHSER’s partial hide becomes Lower, and highlight colours become tags that highlight.
importPlaceholder: Paste uBlacklist rules, a HOHSER export, a Goggle, or one domain per line
importRead_other: Read as $2: $1 sites added and $3 updated.
importSkipped_other: $1 rules with address patterns or unsupported syntax left out; subscribe to the original list to keep them.
backupIntro: Everything in one file: settings, tag choices, subscriptions, and your list.
resetDone: Settings, tags, and subscriptions reset. Your list is kept.
settingsTagline: Hide, rank, and tag search results
cleanupIntro: Anubis can remove the panels on search pages that aren’t results. Turn on each one you’d rather not see. “Show hidden” above the results brings them back for that search.
cleanupEverySearchHint: On means Anubis removes it. Off leaves it on the page.
cleanupAllHint: Turns every switch in this section on or off.
cleanupWebTabHint: Sends every Google search to its Web tab: plain links, with no AI Overview, videos, or other panels, even ones Anubis doesn’t recognise. To leave it for one search, choose All above the results.
cleanupAiHint: Google’s AI Overview and AI Mode tab, DuckDuckGo’s AI-assisted answers and Duck.ai, Bing’s AI answers, and Brave’s AI answers.
cleanupVideosHint: Video and short-video panels between the results.
cleanupQuestionsHint: Lists of other people’s questions with expandable answers.
cleanupDiscussionsHint: Panels of forum threads between the results, like Google’s “Discussions and forums”. Forum pages among the results stay.
cleanupImagesHint: Rows of images between the results. The Images tab still works.
cleanupRelatedHint: Lists of other searches, usually at the bottom of the page.
cleanupElsewhereHint: Rows of buttons that repeat your search on another engine, like Brave’s “Find elsewhere”.
cleanupAdRequestsHint: Banners asking you to turn off your ad blocker or allow ads, like Startpage’s “Block creepy ads, not private search”.
sitesIntro: Sites you’ve ranked or hidden yourself. Your choice beats every list you subscribe to. Use the button on any search result, or add sites here.
sitesTooBig: Your list is too big for browser sync, so it’s saved on this device only. Download it to keep a copy.
sitesNotDomain: That doesn’t look like a domain.
sitesAddHint: It applies to the site and all its subdomains.
sitesAddHelp: Choosing how much of a site
sitesKeptNormal: Kept at normal, whatever your lists say
sitesFirst500: Showing the first 500. Filter to find the rest.
sitesNone: No sites yet. Add one above, or use the button on a search result.
sitesTextIntro: Your list in the Anubis list format: Brave Goggles syntax plus tags. It’s exactly the file you would publish. Lines the table can’t show are kept as written.
listsIntro: Subscribe to lists that tag, rerank, or hide sites. Any text file on GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, or a gist works: Anubis lists, Brave Goggles, uBlacklist rulesets, and plain domain lists.
listsAddHint: Paste a link to the file. Links to a GitHub page, a gist, or a Brave Goggle work too.
listsNone: No lists yet. Pick some from the ones below.
listsMoreIntro: From the Anubis directory and the wider community.
listsShare: Made a list worth sharing? Add it to the directory with a pull request to $1.
listsNeedHttps: Lists must be served over https.
listsPermissionToDownload: Anubis needs permission to read $1 to download this list.
listsSubscribedBundled: Subscribed to $1 (using the copy bundled with Anubis until it can update).
listsUsingBundled: Using the copy bundled with Anubis until it can update ($1).
listsSkippedLines_other: $1 lines skipped: Anubis can’t read that syntax yet.
listLensTitle: A lens hides results the list doesn’t mention
tagsIntro: Lists label results. You decide what each label does: follow the list, only show it, highlight it, or pin, raise, lower, or hide what carries it. Lists that use the same tag name share it.
tagActionFor: What to do with results tagged $1
tagEffectLabel: $1 Only a label: their ranking stays the same.
tagEffectHighlight: $1 Highlights them in the tag’s colour.
tagEffectPin: $1 Pins them to the top of your searches.
tagNoSites: None yet. Add one here, or use the ⚖ button on a search result.
tagNewHint: Your tags are saved in your list, so they go with it when you publish it.
tagNameInvalid: Give the tag a name with at least one letter or number.
tagExists: There is already a tag called “$1”.
tagListsHint: Your lists define these. Decide what each does, and add your own sites to any of them. If a list drops a tag your sites use, it moves to Your tags.
tagNoneYours: No tags of your own yet. Create one above.
reasonLens: doesn’t include it, so it’s hidden
choiceNetSame: so it stays where it was
lineNeedsPattern: Instruction needs a pattern or a site
lineRegexTooLong: Regular expression is longer than $1 characters
lineRegexFreeze: Regular expression could freeze search pages (a repeated group repeats inside): $1
listIsWebPage: Got a web page, not a list. Use the raw file URL.
tagDeleted_other: Deleted the tag “$2” and removed it from $1 sites.
